input: Schedule a deep tissue massage for post-move recovery

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing when the move is happening (or already happened) determines how urgently the appointment needs to be booked and what 'recovery' timing means.
A budget range directly determines which spas, franchises, or independent therapists are realistic options to consider.
Knowing the target city or neighborhood narrows down which providers are geographically accessible after the move.
Whether the user wants to book online themselves, needs help finding a provider, or wants a specific therapist type affects what the next action actually is.
Personal preferences like therapist gender, session length, or specific focus areas (back, shoulders, legs) shape which provider or session type to prioritize.
Knowing if this is just for the user or also for a partner or housemate who also moved changes whether a couples/group booking is needed.
Understanding what 'done well' looks like — e.g., same-week appointment confirmed, specific soreness addressed, a trusted provider found — defines what a successful outcome is.

gold.taskTitle: Book a post-move deep tissue massage
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to schedule a deep tissue massage to help their body recover after a move, but key details about timing, location, preferences, and logistics are still unknown.

questions.title: When is your move happening, or has it passed?
questions.description: Establish whether the move is upcoming, in-progress, or already done to determine booking urgency and ideal appointment timing.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood should the massage be in?
questions.description: Identify the target location so provider search can be scoped to the right area, especially if it is a new city post-move.

questions.title: What is your budget for this massage session?
questions.description: Determine the price range the user is comfortable with to filter between budget franchises, mid-range spas, and premium providers.

questions.title: Do you need help finding a provider, or just booking?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user already has a place in mind and just needs booking steps, or needs research and recommendations as well.

questions.title: Are there specific body areas you need focused on?
questions.description: Moving typically strains the back, shoulders, and legs differently — knowing the priority areas helps match the right therapist and session type.

questions.title: Is this booking just for you, or others too?
questions.description: Determine if a partner, roommate, or family member who also moved needs to be included, which would require a couples or group booking.

questions.title: What would make this massage booking a success?
questions.description: Understand the user's definition of done — e.g., confirmed appointment within the week, a highly-rated therapist, full-body soreness relief — to prioritize the right outcome.
